payload.description: Plexus CustomLogging currently attaches CloudWatch/redaction handlers only to the plexus logger. Host apps such as Call-Criteria import the stdlib logging module from plexus.CustomLogging and call logging.info on the root logger, which used to ship to CloudWatch. Add an explicit opt-in compatibility mode to attach the redacting CloudWatch handler to root/app logging without changing the safer default.
payload.title: Restore root logger CloudWatch shipping for host apps
